title: docs(pm-skill): census `reach: in` is not ADR-0131 D9 admission; the tenancy ledger decides
body:
Fixes #23377

Clause-②: no

## What changes

One reading is added to `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md`, section 读数陷阱 (reading traps), and one same-file restatement is deleted to pay for it at the file's 460-line ceiling. File surface: that one file. No `scripts/**`, no `packages/**`, no other reference.

## Before / after

**Added** (119 bytes; placed after 「⛔ 别处写下的计数值一律先复测再用。」, in the count-is-not-mechanism cluster):

> - 租户普查 `reach: in` 只说有租户列;D9 系统写盖章只认 `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` 的 `tenant-scoped`。

**Deleted** (was line 395, in the required-checks cluster):

> - `in_progress` 不是过;advisory 门禁红进 main 是共享损伤,照样止血立单。

**Its home**: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/reading-discipline.md` lines 24–25. That is the reference this file's own line 3 points to (见 reading-discipline.md):

> - 放行认门禁 job 的结论(`completed: success`),⛔ 不认聚合读数。
> - advisory 门禁红着进 main 是共享损伤,任何车道发现都立即止血并立单,见 landing-operations B。

The deleted line's first half (`in_progress` is not a pass) is the negation of line 24's positive criterion: only `completed: success` releases. AGENTS.md Multi-agent discipline §7 also states it literally ("`in_progress` is not a pass"). The second half is line 25 nearly word for word. Nothing in the deleted line exists only there.

Line budget: 460 → 460 (ceiling 460, headroom 0). Widest line 120 bytes, unchanged.

## Premises, re-read on `4f81f31526` before writing

1. **The census predicate.** `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json` has `"reach": "in"` ×48 and `"reach": "out"` ×35. The predicate is computed at `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs:379–384`: `tenantField = resolveTenantFieldName({ ...def, fields: registeredFields })` and `reach: tenantField === null ? 'out' : 'in'`. `scripts/check-platform-object-tenancy-census.mjs:305` prints the same predicate sentence in the gate's failure text.
2. **The ledger.** `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` is at `packages/objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts:124`, and the class union `tenant-scoped` / `global` / `unclassified` is at :100–106. It has 9 entries, all `tenant-scoped`. An unlisted name is `unclassified` by absence (:244–245).
3. **The early return.** The method is `Engine.resolveSystemInsertOrganization` at `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:6699`. `system-write-organization.ts` holds the pure decision and names that method in its header (:164). At :6717, `if (isPlatformObjectOutOfTenantAuditScope(object)) return undefined;` returns early. That predicate (platform-object-tenancy.ts:261–263) answers true for a platform-namespace object whose class is not `tenant-scoped`. No organization is derived and nothing is refused.

Cross-reading of the two artefacts: 9 of the 48 `reach: in` objects are `tenant-scoped` in the ledger. The other 39 are `reach: in` and take the early return. That is the size of the trap this line names.

Context, all named without a closing verb: the ledger is the one ruled in #13491. The two misreadings the card cites are #23284 and #23256. PR #23340 admitted `sys_notification` to the ledger. The lift for unclassified objects belongs to #15212. This PR is a reading for seats, not a runtime change.

- `pnpm check:agent-test-spelling` · `check:cross-package-test-inputs` · `check:doc-authoring` · `check:driver-memory-census` · `check:gitlink-declared` · `check:nul-bytes` · `check:pm-governed-merges` · `check:pm-half-states` · `check:pm-skill-id-lint` · `check:pm-skill-ratchet` · `check:refd-timer-probe` · `check:required-contexts` · `check:skill-frame-sync` · `check:watch-hint-literal`

Roster families I also ran: `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` 0 · `pnpm check:pm-settings-deny-roster` 0 · `node scripts/check-published-list-mirrors.mjs` 0 · `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 0. `node scripts/check-single-claim-paths.mjs` was NOT MEASURED: it exited 2, NOT WIRED, because it needs the PR context only the workflow supplies.

## Acceptance notes

- The next line, 「⛔ 聚合命令同样不作判定 …」, now follows the required-set lines and not the deleted one. Its 「同样」 still reads against reading-discipline.md line 24's 「⛔ 不认聚合读数」. It is left untouched because the file surface is one line.
- Landing tier: `.claude/**` is Tier S in the `GOVERNED_SURFACES` register. The triage comment's "Tier H" is a misreading of the register. The landing tier is read at landing by `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr`.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:在 PM 席位用的「平台读数事实表」里加了一条:租户普查里的 `reach: in` 只说明找到了租户列,不说明系统写入会被自动盖上组织。会不会盖章,只看 `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` 账本里是不是 `tenant-scoped`。为了不超行数上限,同时删掉一条已经在 reading-discipline.md 里写过的重复规则,文件仍是 460 行。

**为什么改**:同一个席位在一个班次里两次把普查读成「会盖章」,其中一次写进了裁决记录。实测普查里 48 个 `reach: in` 对象,只有 9 个在账本里是 `tenant-scoped`。其余 39 个对象上的裸系统写入,组织列落空,也不会被拒绝。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改给 agent 读的内部参考文件,不进任何发布包,不影响运行时。删掉的那条规则在 reading-discipline.md 里原样保留。回滚就是 revert 这一个提交。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:无需决策。`.claude/**` 属 Tier S,由席位做合同档复核,PASS 后入队落地。
